newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela foreign reserves fall to $12.219 billion.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela foreign reserves fall to $12.219 billion.

text.p: Venezuela's foreign reserves fell $57 million, or 0.5 percent, to $12.219 billion in the week to September 13, according to figures released by the central bank Friday.

Reserves were down from a revised $12.276 billion on September 6, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed, but up $2.517 billion from reserve levels of $9.702 billion on April 19 -- the last working day before exchange levels were lifted on April 22.
From the start of the year, reserve levels are up $2.496 billion, or 26 percent.
Government officials had targeted foreign reserves to grow by $1.5 billion over the course of 1996 as part of Venezuela's IMF-supported economic adjustment program.
Venezuela's foreign reserves fell $1.784 billion, or 15.5 percent, in 1995 to end the year at $9.723 billion.
